problems: congo-free-state (1885-1908) overlaps Cliopatria's Belgian Congo row (1890-1962, owned by af-08); af-08 should start belgian-congo in 1908 or merge the two dossiers.
portuguese-angola (type colony, family portugal) overlaps the coastal parts of Cliopatria's portuguese-empire and kingdom-of-portugal rows (am-06, eu-12); the renderers must decide which is drawn.
kingdom-of-lunda: all three Cliopatria shapes are copies of the Kongo footprint (12.2-16.2 E) and are marked wrong; corrections are discs sized to the page's areas around Musumba.
Every shape of the eleven new states is a proxy (disc, gazetteer region or province); the pages give areas or places, not boundaries.
Kingdom of Kongo is given life 1390-1914 (the page's span) although Cliopatria's row is 1440-1669; the keyframes 1390-1439 and 1670-1914 are new at confidence 1.

Vassal tints that belong to the suzerain's dossier are recorded in portuguese-angola (Ndongo 1626-1671, Matamba from 1683, Kongo 1859-1914) and congo-free-state (Tippu Tip 1887-1892); the Sultan of Zanzibar's claim on the Tippu Tip domain (1884-1887) belongs to the Zanzibar dossier.
Page budget exceeded: Lunda used 4 pages (budget 1-2); Kongo used 4 (budget 1-2) because the civil-war and Soyo keyframes could not be drawn from two pages; portuguese-angola opened 8 pages.
Wikipedia pages that failed to load are listed in pages_failed; the first two have working substitutes.
